name: vereel
description: Add influencer-marketing campaigns to Vereel and search the campaigns brands have already published, in plain language.

interface.longDescription:
Vereel is an influencer-marketing marketplace. Brands publish campaigns, and creators on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and X apply to them.

With this plugin you describe a campaign in plain language and it is written into Vereel for you: the name and description, what the creator produces, which platforms it runs on, the category, the compensation (money, a product, or both), the follower minimum, how long creators may apply, and up to six photos. Categories come from Vereel's own list, so a campaign lands where creators look for it.

Nothing goes public on its own. A campaign you add arrives in your Vereel account as a draft in review, and you publish it yourself at vereel.com, where you see a preview of the campaign as creators will see it and accept the Cooperation Terms for it. The plugin cannot publish, delete, or pay. While a campaign is still in review you can change its fields and photos from here, and you can read Vereel's note if it was returned to you.

You can also search the campaigns that are already public, with no account at all: by words, category, campaign type, platform and language. Payment amounts are not shown there, exactly as they are not shown to an anonymous visitor of the site.

Creators who are signed in can read their Vereel portfolio and rewrite its draft texts — the headline, the about text and the niches. Follower counts and other figures on a portfolio are read by Vereel from the connected platforms and cannot be set from here, and publishing the portfolio stays in the creator's hands.

Signing in happens on vereel.com with OAuth. You choose whether the connection may only read your campaigns, or also create them; creating also asks you to accept the Cooperation Terms. You can disconnect it at any time under Connected apps in your Vereel settings.
capabilities: Write a full influencer-marketing campaign into Vereel from a plain-language brief
Pick the right Vereel category for a campaign from Vereel's own category list
Attach up to six photos to a campaign from https links
Change a campaign's fields and photos while it is still in review
List the brand's campaigns with the status of each one and the reviewer's note
Search the campaigns brands have already published, with no account
Read and rewrite the draft texts of a creator's Vereel portfolio
defaultPrompt: Add a campaign to Vereel for our new vitamin C serum: one Reel and two Stories from beauty creators on Instagram.
Where do my Vereel campaigns stand, and is anything still missing before I can publish them?
Which influencer campaigns are open right now on Vereel for travel creators on TikTok?
